criteria.name: Hook / scroll-stop
criteria.reason: The unchanged 57-character hook still states a concrete position. Its immediate follow-up now credits real preparation and explains the evaluative standard before company background, fixing the prior context-first loss of momentum. It is a strong professional opener, though less surprising than a top-scoring factual hook.

criteria.name: Point of view / take
criteria.reason: The first two paragraphs now state the standard plainly: credit prepared records and editable text, then judge the professional decision that follows. This is a defensible editorial position grounded in the two described handoffs, not a claim that an outcome has been measured. The named Alaska corporate connection follows without invented local benefit.

criteria.reason: Specific KGS/Koniag/Kodiak identity, September 11th provenance, DORA expansion, email subject identifier, APIs, the System for Award Management, prebuilt logic, and separate Jumpstarter/Bedrock drafting give the post substance. criteria.name: Readability & restraint
criteria.reason: The post is shorter at 1506 characters, keeps generous whitespace and separates DORA source/input context from retrieval/logic/responsibility. Removing the later repetition improves its progression. The company-identification paragraph remains relatively dense, so this is not a perfect mobile scan.

criteria.name: Engagement design (CTA + comment-bait)
criteria.reason: The closing question now asks what readers would check in an assembled report or change in a generated draft before use. Those are concrete, distinct actions tied to the argument and can invite examples of professional judgment. It addresses a broad professional audience without demanding confidential details.

criteria.reason: Analytical and fair, with concrete preparation credited before limits. KGS support is company-attributed, earlier Army work remains an AWS vendor case study, and the Koniag corporate relationship never becomes a claim about tribal government or local returns. criteria.reason: Four topically true tail tags span broad AI, Alaska, the named corporation and government technology. This is deliberate and restrained. Live follower/reach tiers were not verified, so the exact broad/mid/niche audience-size mix required for a 10 is not established.
